what: repeated share -> playing -> stop cycles through the deployed service, video_only, silent

modes: receiver_failed: LinkDown: status check before LAUNCH failed (GET_STATUS timeout)
already_running -> stale_app: the 6 s hello probe spent the whole budget

intermediate.note: 1 Hz ownership polling + 12 s lookahead + pump/stop guard: better, not fixed

root_cause: the status retries reused the TLS socket that died with the app restart; every retry burned its own timeout on a dead link (6.5 s) and the share failed
fix: reopen the link between status retries (lib/v020/chromecast.py)
one GET_STATUS per second for ownership instead of four (§3.3 asks for 'within one poll')
media resolution runs in parallel with the app launch (two independent slow halves)
hello probe 6 s -> 3 s before recycling a wedged app
page: a stop racing a fragment append no longer throws; lookahead 20 s -> 12 s

after.note: 10/10 with the 2 h 23 video, first frame 9.4-9.7 s; a separate 6/6 run with the 19 s video gave 3.9-10.3 s

caveat: all of this is the video side. The group half of every transport row still needs an audible window.
